name: QTS Richmond 3

timeline.event: Building 1 shell is mostly complete, with some chillers installed on the roof. Building 2 shell is under construction.
The substation is still under construction, based on a Google Earth image, so we don't think any buildings are operational yet.
The substation looks complete, but we expect Building 1 still needs commissioning before it is fully operational.

Building 1 is operational, based on the substation being completed earlier and cars in the carpark. Building 2 and 3 are not operational, based on minor construction work at the perimeter and no cars in the carpark, but we expect they will…
Building 2 and 3 are operational, based on the previous entry.
Building 4 and 5 are operational, based on Building 5 being roughly 1 year behind Building 1 in satellite imagery.

sources.publisher: Epoch AI, Frontier Data Centers Hub (CC-BY)
sources.quote: QTS Richmond 3: current power 144 MW; owner unlisted.

explain: QTS Richmond 3 is an operating AI data center in Sandston, VA, owned by qts. Epoch AI estimates it draws 144 MW today and 336 MW when finished.
